name: zk-cricket-trader
description: Binary parimutuel cricket match-winner market on Mina

scripts.build: npm run build -w @zk-cricket/shared && npm run build -w @zk-cricket/contracts && npm run build -w @zk-cricket/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @zk-cricket/shared && npm run typecheck -w @zk-cricket/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @zk-cricket/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @zk-cricket/shared && npm run test -w @zk-cricket/shared && npm run test -w @zk-cricket/contracts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @zk-cricket/shared && npm run test:e2e -w @zk-cricket/contracts
scripts.demo: npm run build -w @zk-cricket/shared && concurrently -n demo,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run demo -w @zk-cricket/contracts" "npm run dev -w @zk-cricket/web"
